references.title: Nightglass
references.role: Original full Nightglass; drawing and world benchmark, not cast selection
observations: Original full board: expressive dark-haired adult in cropped white coat, dark organic flying creature, cyan luminous openings, deep inhabited city. Strong designed silhouettes and selective face detail, but fine city/water marks remain. Drawing/world benchmark only; do not import its cast or two-view sheet layout into story panels.

references.title: Riven
references.role: Recurring adult identity and saber construction only
observations: Silver swept hair, narrow adult face with sly asymmetric mouth, petrol cropped jacket, black shoulder plate/gloves and one narrow curved cyan-edged saber. Whole-figure and portrait agree. Preserve one continuous hilt-to-blade construction and distinctive silhouette; source portrait framing is not a camera prescription.

references.title: Neris
references.role: Recurring adult identity; rear shield grip must be correctly redrawn
observations: Mature brown-haired adult with low knot, ivory shoulder pieces, teal split tunic, dark trousers/boots and large dark crescent shield. Grip is visible on the near rear side of the shield; correct topology must remain consistent as camera and shield rotate, rather than copying its screen-side orientation.

references.title: Kellan
references.role: Recurring adult identity and broad combat sword
observations: Black curly-haired adult, open toothy expression, sand double-breasted jacket/cobalt inset, pale boots. Broad long blade with a continuous hilt and both bare hands behind guard. Watch later swords narrowing into generic sabers or power scenes losing blade-water contact.

references.title: Ilyra
references.role: Recurring adult identity and Axis Lance; do not copy ambiguous violet barrier
observations: Copper chin-length bob, angular adult face, burgundy coat/ivory shoulder mantle, full ivory/dark Axis Lance with dark triangular gold-edged spearhead and grounded butt. Reference violet weather curtain does not demonstrate changed gravity; copy identity/equipment, not its ambiguous effect or extra background adults.

references.title: Finish
references.role: Approved broad surfaces, contours and faces; not target composition
observations: Broad clean armor plates, quiet masonry, facial planes and sharp selective edges preserve a close two-adult crossing. It is a surface benchmark, not independent proof of blade pressure and not the target framing for every shot.

references.title: Shield
references.role: Rear shield grip and coherent force contact example
observations: Actual Q02-F1 depicts mouth pressure striking the right-facing convex shield face and splitting around a protected companion. Neris hand is visibly on her own rear side of the crescent, behind the outer pressure surface. Her extended arm is fairly straight; use this for topology, not a universal bent-arm brace claim. Small feet overlap the bridge rail and exact rear anatomy cannot be certified from this single view.
